시편 88:1.content: A Song or Psalm for the sons of Korah, to the chief Musician upon Mahalath Leannoth, Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite. O Lord God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:

시편 88:2.content: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;

시편 88:3.content: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.

시편 88:4.content: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:

시편 88:5.content: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.

시편 88:6.content: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.

시편 88:7.content: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.

시편 88:8.content: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.

시편 88:9.content: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: Lord, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.

시편 88:10.content: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.

시편 88:11.content: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?

시편 88:12.content: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

시편 88:13.content: But unto thee have I cried, O Lord; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.

시편 88:14.content: Lord, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?

시편 88:15.content: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.

시편 88:16.content: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.

시편 88:17.content: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.

시편 88:18.content: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.
